notes.title: New menus, better visuals, smoother experience.
notes.content: [p]I’ve reworked the entire UI to make everything clearer, cleaner, and easier to use.[/p][p]From the main menu to in game elements, everything looks and feels better. This is just one of many updates I’m making to polish the game before release![/p][p]I have gotten good and harsh feedback about my UI, so I decided to remake it, and now I think I am on the right path![/p][p]Right now, I am working on the cosmetic UI. I will post an update on that when it's done![/p][p]In game Ui.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575832/f48ba58ecff35ab5344ac43b9e71da5ace84d4e9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Meny Ui.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575832/f8fdd403734794005b450f78e858fd2174eed63a.jpg"][/img][/p]
